scenario: Extreme but schema-valid positive durations and non-negative integer benefits
expected_notes: Large values are intended to probe numeric and solver limits, not assert that every solver configuration must prove optimality.
A 1-minute duration and zero benefit are valid under the inspected contract.
Out-of-domain values such as negative durations and floating-point benefits are isolated in invalid_inputs.
important_contract_notes: Inventory asset_id must equal the asset external_identifier used when registering assets.
Estimate keys must be <asset external_identifier>:<OSV vulnerability id>.
Only affected installations with a fixed version and matching estimate should become approved patch actions.
Package dependency edges are not represented in inventory_offline.json; do not invent a field for them.
